capabilities.dependency: Formula parser, typed computational view, versioned client protocol, MCP tool contracts and isolated code runtime
capabilities.implementation: Run the calculation engine as a headless package or dedicated process with no UI or persistence imports. It reads and writes only through the versioned typed computational view, never through XLSX, SQL, API or DataFrame implementations. Expose commands, snapshots and subscriptions for cell or range changes, collaborator edits and recalculation completion through the versioned protocol. UIs use that protocol directly; the product-native AI Agent acts through MCP tools while third-party clients can use the same versioned surface. Add a capability-secured code sandbox for deterministic, side-effect-free formula evaluation with no ambient network, filesystem, clock or randomness, plus CPU, memory and recursion limits. Keep parsing, dependency tracking, dirty propagation, multithreaded scheduling and iterative solving behind the engine boundary.
capabilities.scope: Dependency DAG, recalculation chain, iterative circular solving, volatile functions and automatic or manual calculation controls
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. The calculation engine remains independently testable and deployable. Web and desktop share one stable client protocol, the native AI Agent uses MCP and custom code runs inside a bounded sandbox rather than inheriting host authority.

capabilities.dependency: Calculation engine, typed computational view, function registry and isolated code runtime
capabilities.implementation: Keep formula text Excel-shaped while binding references to stable identities in the typed computational view. Treat the full discovered Insert > Function catalog as the coverage corpus, grouped by its Array, Database, Date, Engineering, Filter, Financial, Google, Info, Logical, Lookup, Math, Operator, Parser, Statistical, Text and Web categories rather than splitting it into hundreds of tracks. Implement common functions through libraries and the long tail through a versioned registry with shared array and error semantics. IMPORTDATA, IMPORTHTML, IMPORTXML, IMPORTRANGE and GOOGLEFINANCE request data through permissioned connector and adapter boundaries, then project results into the view. Add an explicit deterministic code-evaluation function as our own extension.
capabilities.scope: Excel and Google Sheets function coverage, arrays, LET, LAMBDA, sandboxed custom code and external-data functions
capabilities.verdict: Buildable in compatibility bands, with sandboxed code evaluation as a first-class extension beyond Excel and Sheets. The function long tail is implemented against behavioral tests, not left as an unsupported mystery.

capabilities.dependency: Versioned engine protocol, typed computational view and engine snapshots
capabilities.implementation: Build a canvas or virtualized DOM grid as a pure client of the versioned engine protocol. Cover show or hide, freeze panes, zoom, gridlines, formulas, formula bar, full screen and hidden sheets; clipboard, undo or redo, all paste-special variants, delete, move and find or replace; inserting and deleting rows, columns, cells and sheets; merge, theme, number formats, fonts, text styles, alignment, wrapping, rotation, colors, borders and clear formatting; spell check and personal dictionary; the complete toolbar, name box, formula bar, sheet tabs and Hide the menus. The UI owns viewport and unsaved edit state, sends typed operations and never assumes which storage adapter backs the view.
capabilities.scope: Grid rendering, selection, editing, View and Format controls, toolbar, formula bar, name box, sheets and editor commands
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. The grid stays replaceable and contains no calculation logic, so web, desktop and mobile clients can share one engine.

capabilities.dependency: Typed range model, drawing layer and adapter metadata hooks
capabilities.implementation: Create our own chart specification over typed view ranges, render it with an established chart library and let the XLSX adapter preserve unsupported OOXML records for round-trip.
capabilities.scope: Insert Chart, toolbar chart creation, common chart types, embedded charts and sparklines
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. Common charts are direct; uncommon Excel variants become explicit renderers added against compatibility fixtures.

capabilities.dependency: Typed table model, aggregation engine and adapter snapshots
capabilities.implementation: Build a columnar aggregation engine over typed tables with our own pivot definition, grouping operators and cache refresh layer, independent of both the visual renderer and the storage adapter.
capabilities.scope: Insert Pivot table, grouping, aggregation, Add a slicer and pivot-linked charts
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. Existing primitives accelerate aggregation, while our pivot model supplies the workbook behavior and compatibility mapping.

capabilities.dependency: Storage adapter SDK, connector sandbox, credential boundary, scheduler and query execution engine
capabilities.implementation: Build transformations as a typed DAG that reads from and writes through storage adapters, with a connector SDK, credential sandbox and visual step editor. Project each result into the computational view instead of making the engine own imported copies. Translate the supported M surface into that graph and let the XLSX adapter retain unsupported source text for incremental coverage.
capabilities.scope: File Import, Data connectors, Data extraction, shaping steps, joins and refreshable transformations
capabilities.verdict: Buildable by functional parity. Users get import, shaping, joins and refresh through our own engine; M-language coverage expands through a translator rather than blocking the product.

capabilities.dependency: Grid, formula engine, typed computational view, rule model and optimization libraries
capabilities.implementation: Implement sort sheet or range, create filter, filter views, validation, remove duplicates, trim whitespace, cleanup suggestions, split text to columns, randomize range, conditional formatting, alternating colors, column stats, Checkbox and Dropdown as typed-view operations. Route persisted mutations through the active storage adapter. Keep deterministic suggestion results inspectable, and place Solver behind a pluggable optimization interface backed by linear, integer and nonlinear solvers.
capabilities.scope: Sort, filters and views, validation, cleanup, split columns, randomize, formatting rules, stats, native inputs, what-if and Solver
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. The common tools are direct and Solver gets a defined service boundary instead of being deferred as merely hard.

capabilities.dependency: Sandbox, typed view mutation API, storage adapter transactions, permissions, event model, recorder and migration tooling
capabilities.implementation: Create a permissioned TypeScript automation API over the engine protocol and typed computational view, plus an action recorder and event runtime. Persist writes through adapter capabilities and transactions. Translate common VBA patterns into that runtime, let the XLSX adapter preserve original projects and isolate unmigrated Windows automation in a compatibility runner.
capabilities.scope: Workbook automation, Extensions > Macros recording, import and management, recorded actions and scripted behavior
capabilities.verdict: Buildable by function. Macro recording and automation run in our secure runtime; legacy VBA is translated or bridged rather than reimplemented byte for byte.

capabilities.dependency: Storage adapter SDK, ZIP package reader, XML model, binary adapters and round-trip corpus
capabilities.implementation: Implement OOXML as the required XLSX storage adapter, not as the engine's internal model. File Import enters through format and storage adapters. File Download exports Microsoft Excel, OpenDocument, PDF, CSV, TSV and web representations from a versioned typed-view snapshot. The XLSX adapter edits known package parts, preserves unknown parts verbatim and uses conversion boundaries for binary workbooks while retaining embedded macro packages.
capabilities.scope: OOXML .xlsx, .xlsm and .xlsb plus File Import and Download for Excel, ODS, PDF, CSV, TSV and web output
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. Strong .xlsx compatibility is native, while .xlsm and .xlsb reach functional parity through preservation and tested adapters.

capabilities.dependency: Typed computational view, adapter write capabilities, identity, realtime transport, operation log and history store
capabilities.implementation: Represent edits as typed cell, range and structure operations against versioned computational-view snapshots. Apply server sequencing, optimistic local updates, rebasing rules and per-cell authorship, then commit through adapters that advertise writable and transactional capabilities.
capabilities.scope: Share, Email, comments, notes, presence, version history, notifications, protection, conflict resolution and co-authoring
capabilities.verdict: Buildable with our own collaboration protocol. Spreadsheet-aware operations and deterministic rebasing provide functional parity without cloning Microsoft's sync service.

capabilities.dependency: Sandbox, engine protocol, columnar storage adapter, typed view and expression compiler
capabilities.implementation: Define capability-scoped add-in APIs and worker-isolated custom functions over the engine protocol. Implement analytical data as a columnar storage adapter with a typed-view projection, relationships, vectorized aggregation and an expression layer that can translate a supported DAX surface. The core engine consumes that view and does not own the columnar store.
capabilities.scope: Named functions, named ranges, add-ons, AppSheet, custom functions and a Power Pivot-style columnar model
capabilities.verdict: Buildable by function. The analytical model is a deep program, but its architecture is concrete and does not depend on reproducing xVelocity internally.

capabilities.dependency: Shared engine core, typed computational view, storage adapters, versioned client protocol, MCP server, offline sync and platform shells
capabilities.implementation: Ship one headless engine core behind a versioned protocol. Host it as a service for web clients, package the identical core with desktop and mobile apps for local execution and expose its typed cell, range, formula and recalc operations through an MCP server. Every host supplies the same computational-view and storage-adapter boundaries. Offline logs replay typed operations through the engine, while persistence remains adapter-owned.
capabilities.scope: Web, desktop and mobile clients plus New, Open, copy, rename, trash, settings, Help, menu search and keyboard shortcuts
capabilities.verdict: Buildable across all three platforms, the native AI Agent and third-party client workflows. Workbook behavior comes from one independent engine that can run hosted or packaged locally, while each UI and MCP client evolves without forking calculation semantics.

capabilities.dependency: Headless engine, versioned typed-view snapshots, calculation DAG, thread-safe function runtime and deterministic scheduler
capabilities.implementation: Inside the engine process, build the dirty dependency DAG from a versioned computational-view snapshot and partition it into dependency-safe ready queues. A configurable worker pool runs independent branches across Web Workers or native threads, while a deterministic coordinator commits computed results back through the view, handles cancellation and isolates volatile or non-thread-safe functions. Threads never open or mutate storage directly.
capabilities.scope: Multi-threaded recalculation, deterministic scheduling and automatic, manual and partial calculation modes
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. Multithreading is an engine capability, not a UI optimization. Single-thread fallback, deterministic results and automatic, manual and partial calc modes are part of the contract.

capabilities.dependency: Chart renderer, typed table model, pivot engine and XLSX adapter metadata
capabilities.implementation: Render sparklines from typed-view range specifications and bind slicer or timeline controls to the table and pivot filter model. XLSX-specific cache and drawing metadata stays in the XLSX adapter.
capabilities.scope: In-cell charts plus visual filters for tables and pivots
capabilities.verdict: Buildable as normal product engineering. The compatibility tail is preserving Excel-specific styling and pivot cache details.

capabilities.dependency: Typed value registry, provider adapter contracts, entity resolution, caching and rich cell rendering
capabilities.implementation: Define typed rich cell values in the computational view, backed by provider storage adapters, cached versioned snapshots and explicit refresh policies. The engine consumes their values and provenance without owning provider persistence.
capabilities.scope: People, File, Calendar event, Finance and Rating smart chips plus stocks, geography and extensible rich values
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. Matching Microsoft's exact providers is not required for functional parity; reliable typed values and refresh behavior are.

capabilities.dependency: Inference service, typed computational view, formula engine, profiling and explainable transformation plans
capabilities.implementation: Combine deterministic pattern synthesis for Flash Fill with autocomplete, formula corrections, named-function suggestions, dropdown and smart-chip suggestions plus Data cleanup suggestions. It reads versioned typed-view snapshots and produces inspectable formulas, transformations, pivots and charts through normal engine operations. This intelligence layer proposes deterministic workbook operations; the product-native AI Agent can call it through shared MCP tools and can also react proactively to subscribed events.
capabilities.scope: Deterministic autocomplete, formula and smart-chip suggestions, cleanup suggestions, pattern inference and automatic analysis
capabilities.verdict: Buildable by functionality. It needs an intelligence layer with validation, not a clone of Excel's private models.

capabilities.dependency: Typed range model, map renderer, geocoding, animation timeline and adapter drawing persistence
capabilities.implementation: Use a WebGL globe or map renderer, geocoding adapters and a scene model driven by typed-view ranges. Persist only through the active adapter's drawing and metadata capabilities.
capabilities.scope: Geocoded rows, animated geographic scenes, time playback and layered data visualization
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. Geographic visualization is a bounded subsystem; exact Power Map scene round-tripping is the compatibility tail.

capabilities.dependency: Typed computational view, drawing layer, event model, sandbox and XLSX package preservation
capabilities.implementation: Build safe native form controls bound to typed-view values and operations. Let the XLSX adapter preserve legacy ActiveX package parts and provide a migration layer for supported behaviors.
capabilities.scope: Safe native Checkbox and Dropdown controls, buttons, list controls, workbook bindings and legacy embedded Windows controls
capabilities.verdict: Buildable for the functionality. Native ActiveX execution is Windows-specific and unsafe, so compatibility should preserve or migrate rather than clone it.

capabilities.dependency: XLSX storage adapter, OOXML package layer, key derivation, encryption and secure password handling
capabilities.implementation: Implement protection and encryption inside the XLSX storage adapter behind a reviewed cryptographic boundary. The engine receives only the authorized typed view and remains independent of file passwords and package formats.
capabilities.scope: Protect sheets and ranges, cell and workbook protection plus password-encrypted file open and save
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. Protection flags are straightforward; secure encrypted-package compatibility needs rigorous cryptographic implementation and test vectors.

capabilities.dependency: Storage adapter SDK, typed computational view, connector sandbox, refresh scheduler, streaming transport and trust policy
capabilities.implementation: Build permissioned streaming storage adapters that project refreshable values into the typed computational view. Let the XLSX adapter preserve external-link metadata and isolate any legacy DDE bridge outside the engine and formula runtime.
capabilities.scope: Workbook links, refreshable real-time values and legacy Windows inter-process data exchange
capabilities.verdict: Buildable by function. External links and RTD map cleanly to modern connectors; DDE should be preserved or bridged, not re-created inside the product.

capabilities.dependency: Versioned engine snapshots, font metrics, layout engine, drawing layer, adapter metadata and PDF or platform print output
capabilities.implementation: Create a deterministic pagination engine that measures the same typed content and drawing snapshot used by screen rendering. Export print-ready pages as a client of the engine protocol, with page setup persistence delegated to capable storage adapters.
capabilities.scope: File > Print, pagination, print areas, scaling, margins, headers, footers and page breaks
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. It is a substantial rendering program because page breaks and sizing must remain stable across platforms.

capabilities.dependency: Formula parser, typed value codec, locale packs, adapter serialization and number and date formatting
capabilities.implementation: Keep an invariant engine formula language over stable typed-view identities and translate tokens only at editor and storage-adapter boundaries using locale registries.
capabilities.scope: Localized function names, separators, number formats, dates and formula display
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. Localization belongs at parse and display boundaries, while stored workbook formulas remain canonical.

capabilities.dependency: Semantic grid, engine protocol, adapter metadata, keyboard model and enterprise policy services
capabilities.implementation: Build accessibility into the grid and protocol-driven authoring model, add an inspectable checker and integrate sensitivity metadata through policy and storage-adapter metadata capabilities. Classification does not become calculation-engine state.
capabilities.scope: Tools > Accessibility, screen-reader and keyboard support, checks, alt text and policy-backed classification labels
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. Accessibility is fully product-owned; sensitivity enforcement depends on the target organization's identity and policy system.

capabilities.dependency: Sandbox service, Python environment registry, typed computational view, adapter blob capability and calculation DAG
capabilities.implementation: Add a PY formula that submits code plus immutable computational-view range snapshots to an isolated Python worker. The worker runs a pinned package environment with no ambient host access, resource and time limits and content-addressed result caching. Typed tables return as spill ranges, scalars as cells and charts as typed drawing results. The engine places them into its result snapshot, while durable writes and blobs flow through adapter capabilities. The dependency graph invalidates execution only when referenced inputs, code or environment versions change.
capabilities.scope: Python formulas, DataFrame analysis, statistical libraries and plots returned into workbook cells
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. Excel already validates the model with Python in Excel. We can provide the same functional class with a first-class engine boundary, reproducible environments and both hosted and packaged execution policies.

capabilities.dependency: Language sandboxes, permission broker, typed-view transaction API, storage adapter commits, event scheduler, connector boundary and MCP server
capabilities.implementation: Provide one capability-secured runtime with two explicit lanes. Pure custom functions and EVAL execute inside the recalc graph over immutable typed-view inputs, without network, filesystem, clock or mutation. Automation scripts run outside recalc with declared permissions and typed-view transactions that storage adapters commit, plus event triggers, audit logs and user-controlled network connectors. Apps Script and Office Scripts patterns translate onto this API, while MCP exposes the same approved operations to the native AI Agent and authorized third-party clients.
capabilities.scope: Extensions > Apps Script plus JavaScript, TypeScript and Python automation, custom functions, jobs and agent analysis
capabilities.verdict: Buildable without weakening the engine. The pure lane stays deterministic and parallel-safe; the automation lane supports real code and side effects through explicit permissions instead of smuggling them into cell recalculation.

capabilities.dependency: Adapter SDK, schema discovery, typed value model, snapshot tokens and write capability negotiation
capabilities.implementation: Define a versioned storage adapter contract for discovery, typed reads, writes, snapshots and change feeds. XLSX is one required adapter, not the engine's internal data model. SQL, API and DataFrame adapters can project tables or ranges without copying the source into an Excel-shaped file. Storage owns persistence while the engine owns calculation semantics.
capabilities.scope: File Import and Download, Data connectors, XLSX, SQL, APIs, DataFrames and future sources behind one storage boundary
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. Calculation no longer assumes where data lives. XLSX compatibility remains a first-class adapter while databases, APIs and DataFrames keep their native storage models.

capabilities.dependency: Storage adapters, type registry, lineage model, versioned snapshots and calculation DAG
capabilities.implementation: Normalize adapter schemas into typed scalar, table, array, error and drawing values with stable identities. Formulas target this computational view rather than storage-specific records. The view tracks lineage, nullability, units, versions and writable capabilities so recalculation is deterministic and mutations can be routed back to the correct adapter.
capabilities.scope: A stable cell, range and table projection over any connected storage backend
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. This is the seam that lets one engine calculate over files, databases, APIs or DataFrames without forcing every source into a workbook file.

capabilities.dependency: Shared engine command and event protocol, typed computational view, storage adapter write capabilities, MCP server, authorization, audit log, typed value codec and sandbox runtime
capabilities.implementation: Publish versioned MCP tools over the engine command model: read_cells, write_cells, set_formulas, recalculate, get_results and execute_code. Add permissioned subscriptions for cell and range changes, collaborator edits and recalculation completion, with resumable cursors, delivery policy and audit records. Requests address stable identities in the typed computational view and responses carry typed values, engine version, snapshot token and explicit error contracts. Writes flow through the view to the active storage adapter. The product-native AI Agent and authorized third-party clients use this same tool surface, permission model and audit trail. The same authority boundary gates sandboxed code invoked from MCP or formulas.
capabilities.scope: Typed agent tools plus event subscriptions for cells, ranges, collaborator edits, recalculation and results
capabilities.verdict: Buildable. One native AI Agent uses the versioned tool, permission and event interface while the grid remains a direct protocol client and third-party integrations remain clients, not product components. Proactive behavior does not require extra authority.

capabilities.dependency: MCP tool and event protocol, engine event subscriptions, shared authorization and audit trail, typed computational view, Flash Fill and analysis services and product surfaces
capabilities.implementation: Place the one AI Agent inside the Icecream Sheets web service as a native product component used by the user. Chat is one surface, not its boundary. It acts through the MCP server's versioned tools under the shared permission model and audit trail, with no private engine pipe and no direct storage access. Engine event subscriptions for cell or range changes, collaborator edits and recalculation completion support proactive notifications, background monitoring and suggestions from the start. Deterministic autocomplete, formula, cleanup and smart-chip proposals remain in Flash Fill and analysis; the agent can call them as tools and decide when to surface them.
capabilities.scope: In-product agent with Gemini-style side panel, Alt+Shift+G menu, chat and proactive surfaces, MCP tools, notifications, monitoring and suggestion controls
capabilities.verdict: New component. Buildable as the product-native MCP agent with reactive and proactive behavior. Third parties remain clients of the same tools, not another agent component. One interface avoids split permissions, duplicated audit logic and a future retrofit for background monitoring.
